import os import sqlite3 import uuid from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, g app = Flask(__name__) app.secret_key = 'dev-secret-key' DATABASE = 'db.sqlite3' def get_db(): db = getattr(g, '_database', None) if db is None: db = g._database = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE) db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return db @app.teardown_appcontext def close_db(exception): db = getattr(g, '_database', None) if db is not None: db.close() def init_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE) try: conn.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recipes ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, ingredients TEXT NOT NULL, instructions TEXT NOT NULL ) ''') conn.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL, comment TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes(id) ) ''') conn.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ratings ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL, rating INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes(id) ) ''') conn.execute(''' CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ratings_recipe_id ON ratings(recipe_id) ''') conn.execute(''' CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comments_recipe_id ON comments(recipe_id) ''') conn.commit() finally: conn.close() @app.route('/recipes', methods=['GET']) def get_recipes(): conn = get_db() cur = conn.cursor() cur.execute(''' SELECT id, title FROM recipes ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10 ''') rows = cur.fetchall() html = '

Recipe Overview

''', (recipe_id, title, str(ingredients), instructions)) conn.commit() except Exception as e: conn.rollback() return jsonify({'error': 'Failed to save recipe'}), 500 recipe = { 'id': recipe_id, 'title': title, 'ingredients': ingredients, 'instructions': instructions, 'comments': [], 'avgRating': None } return jsonify(recipe), 201 @app.route('/recipes/', methods=['GET']) def get_recipe(recipeId): conn = get_db() cur = conn.cursor() cur.execute('SELECT * FROM recipes WHERE id = ?', (recipeId,)) recipe = cur.fetchone() if recipe is None: return '', 404 cur.execute('SELECT comment FROM comments WHERE recipe_id = ?', (recipeId,)) comments = [row['comment'] for row in cur.fetchall()] cur.execute(''' SELECT AVG(rating) FROM ratings WHERE recipe_id = ?
